faq_heading: Homes near Topham Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Topham Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Topham Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Topham Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Topham Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are James Kennedy Elementary (0.6 km west), des Voyageurs (0.8 km south) and West Langley Elementary (1.1 km north-west).

How the Topham Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Topham Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Topham Elementary

13 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Topham Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 2 other, 1 secondary, 1 middle; 1 independent). The closest is James Kennedy Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (2.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: James Kennedy Elementary (0.6 km west), des Voyageurs (0.8 km south), West Langley Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Alex Hope Elementary (1.5 km south-west), Gordon Greenwood Elementary (2.0 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is James Kennedy Elementary, 0.6 km west of Topham Elementary.
